name: Guangdong Electric Power Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Electric Power Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops and operates electric power projects in the People's Republic of China. The company engages in investment, construction, and operation management of power projects and new energy projects; production and sales of electric power; technical consulting and services in the power industry; leasing of terminal facilities; and general cargo storage, loading and unloading, and shipment service.
